_comment: Two entries, so `x.cjs` is in a chunk that both entries can load. `deferred.js` has an unread `import defer` of `x.cjs`, and `eager.js` imports `x.cjs` for its side effect, with no interop. A deferred import statement does not reference `__toESM`: only an access or an escape does. Thus no chunk has `__toESM`. `minify` stays off, so that the helper keeps its name for the check in `_test.mjs`. The `cjs` variant checks the `cjs` output.
